title: Four degree-50 cyclic components with a six-table 34-operation cube and retuned anchor budgets

claims.statement: The explicit product of four five-field degree-50 cyclic codes, with its fixed radius-50 adaptive list decoder, carries 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 59125678112425065941180357685609/100000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=147573824270637055360 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(67/1).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), all 65 averaged pair cutoffs with exact signed shell sums (1), exact child removal counts by noise weight (2), and full cumulative occupancy and error (3). Part zero checks the six-table cube and tight fixed-cap work with 15 organizer-counter replays, and part two checks the retuned true-path weights.
